  {"id": 4, "label": "ends justify means", "description": "This means believing that the ends justify the means: behaving decently and honorably while little is at stake, but once the stakes become high enough being willing to do whatever the goal requires, no matter how heinous or dishonorable, with no line a large enough reason cannot make one cross."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "principled", "description": "This means demonstrating adherence to a consistent ethical framework and clearly stated values, making decisions based on moral rules rather than situational convenience or pragmatic compromise."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "relativist", "description": "This means believing that truth and morality are entirely dependent on context, perspective, and cultural background, rejecting the existence of universal or objective standards."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "rigid", "description": "This means insisting on the one right way and proper conditions, never bending the plan when circumstances change, and leaving the job undone rather than done differently."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "flexible", "description": "This means showing adaptability by accepting imperfect situations, working within constraints and limitations, and adjusting approaches when circumstances change rather than insisting on ideal conditions."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "strong-willed", "description": "This means doing what one has set one's mind on: no advice, coaxing or pressure talks one out of it, and one pushes it through over everyone's objections."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "unyielding", "description": "This means stating one's position and holding it however the person pushes or pleads, giving no ground for peace, and leaving them to adjust."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "flustered", "description": "This means being easily flustered: thrown by every surprise, setback and provocation, losing the thread and the tone under any pressure, apologizing and repeating oneself, and showing it each time."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "absolutist", "description": "This means maintaining that certain truths, values, and principles are universal and unchanging, applying to all people and situations without exception or cultural variation."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "honorable", "description": "This means keeping a code of things that are never done however high the stakes, holding that the ends do not justify the means, that some acts simply cannot be justified, even when they would win, save a great many lives, and accepting the loss when one's code and one's goal conflict."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "fundamentalist", "description": "This means showing strict adherence to basic principles without compromise, flexibility, or alternative interpretation, often rejecting nuanced approaches or modern adaptations."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "treacherous", "description": "This means turning on one's friends, partner and team when it pays, selling their secrets, and switching sides the moment the other side offers more."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "unflappable", "description": "This means staying composed whatever lands, taking the surprise, the setback and the provocation without losing the thread or the tone, and never visibly flustered."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "accommodating", "description": "This means readily adjusting one's positions and approach to meet other people's needs and keep the peace, even when it means giving up an initial stance."}
 ]}

  {"id": 9, "label": "magnanimous", "description": "This means letting slights and small injuries pass without remark, giving even a rival full credit, and counting a grudge over a trifle as beneath one."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "distractible", "description": "This means having one's attention pulled off the task by every buzz, noise or passing thought, drifting mid-sentence and losing the thread."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "petty", "description": "This means focusing on trivial grievances, making disproportionate issues out of minor slights, or treating insignificant problems as if they were major concerns."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "course-correcting", "description": "This means stepping back from the current approach when needed to ask whether its assumptions still hold, whether initial evidence was conclusive, noticing early when things are not working, and changing tack, even at the cost of work already done."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "absentee", "description": "This means handing over the work and vanishing, giving no direction when asked, never checking how it is going, and hearing that it went wrong from someone else."},

  {"id": 15, "label": "focused", "description": "This means keeping one's attention on the task through every buzz, noise or passing thought, and finishing each thing before turning to the next."},

 ]}

 "traits": [

  {"id": 10, "label": "accommodating", "description": "This means readily adjusting one's positions and approach to meet other people's needs and keep the peace, even when it means giving up an initial stance."},

 ]}
